summary: KMAX is a Muay Thai gym in Krabi Town offering group and private classes for adults and kids, a fitness gym, and Muay Chaiya lessons on request.

facts.label: Schedule
facts.value: Group classes Saturday to Thursday, closed Fridays
facts.quote: Group classes run Saturday to Thursday.

facts.label: Certification
facts.value: Certified by the Board of Boxing Sport, Sports Authority of Thailand
facts.quote: KMAX Gym is certified by the Board of Boxing Sport, Sports Authority of Thailand, under the Ministry of Tourism and Sports.

facts.label: Head trainer
facts.value: Kru Rak, former stadium fighter and 67 kg champion
facts.quote: Former stadium fighter and 67 kg champion.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Krabi Town, about 25 minutes from Ao Nang
facts.quote: About 25 minutes from Ao Nang by car or songthaew.
